title: Asset and Safehouse
author: Rafael Marchetti
blurb: Rosalind Fairweather, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
